name: Pork Shoulder
siboNotes: Plain pork shoulder is FODMAP-free and well-tolerated on SIBO diets. Avoid marinades or rubs containing garlic, onion, or high-FODMAP ingredients.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like rosemary, thyme, or oregano
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Slow-cook or braise for tender, easily digestible results
Remove excess fat before cooking to reduce digestive stress
nutritionalHighlights: High in complete protein (20-25g per serving)
Rich in B vitamins, especially B12 and niacin
Good source of zinc and selenium
